description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing self-serve hot pot chain with a Richmond Ackroyd location offering over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 18 broths and dry mixes. Diners choose their own broth — from Signature Mala to Tomato to Tom Yum — and cook their own selection of premium meats, seafood, and vegetables at the table. The restaurant has indoor seating only and is part of a rapidly expanding BC-and-beyond brand with locations across the Lower Mainland, Ontario, and California.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (14 spaces) at 41m; rack at 53m; rack at 68m; rack at 80m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Big Way Hot Pot is an active multi-location chain with a 'Richmond Ackroyd' branch listed in its navigation, consistent with the OSM record. The Tomato Broth page explicitly states 'Vegan Option Available,' and a product page references 'Order via app,' indicating app-based ordering exists. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi claims appear anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, and no phone number is available from either source; the contact page address (2633 Viking Wy #208) appears to be corporate HQ rather than the Ackroyd restaurant location.
concerns: Website contains substantial placeholder/template content mixed with real content: 'Lorem ipsum' text, 'contact@sushi.com' email addresses, and US placeholder phone numbers (e.g. '(414) 345-3245') appear throughout multiple pages, suggesting an unfinished website build.

Contact page address (2633 Viking Wy #208, Richmond, BC V6V 3B7) does not match the OSM restaurant address (8100 Ackroyd Road, Unit 175, Richmond); the contact page address appears to be a corporate/head office, not the Ackroyd restaurant location — OSM address could not be confirmed via website.
No phone number available for this specific location from OSM or website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with confirmed operations and a named Richmond Ackroyd location on the chain's own website. No indicators of closure or phantom listing.
